title: Paths 1–4: reschedule, confirmation, a photo the engine closes, the result handed to the doctor
purpose: María (synthetic) is offered a Tuesday, says she cannot on Tuesday and already had the test (path 2: new slots without Tuesday and an invitation to send the report), confirms option 2 (path 1: booked only on that explicit yes; the engine closes the visit order from the FHIR Appointment), sends a photo of her HbA1c report (path 3: Muse Spark vision reads it, the agent submits a FHIR Observation and the engine, not the agent, closes the HbA1c order), and the abnormal value goes to the doctor (path 4: clinical reviewer findings and a pre-visit question with citations), while María only hears that her doctor will review it.
